responseMessageContents.text:
Version history isn't a feature within the app itself — it's a Rork platform feature. In the Rork web interface, you should see a **"History"** or **"Versions"** panel on the left sidebar or in the project settings area. Each time I make changes, a new version is saved there, and you can click on any previous version to preview or restore it.

If you're looking to revert to a previous version of your app (like the old colors), just find the version you want in that history panel and click **Restore**.
